HOW TO READ AN ENDORSEMENT

A reference.
A reason to start a review.

The issuer signs a contributor’s account, a purpose, and an expiry. Each repository decides whose recommendations to accept.

Portable
The same JSON works across repository policies.
Revocable
Withdrawal is checked against ENS history on the next verification.
Yours to operate
This entire workspace can run locally.
i

Endorsements do not prove code quality, human identity, or an agent’s authority. Keep your normal review process.
